Stock market news | Sensex plunges 1,484 points amid bank sell-off

On 23 November 2026, Indian benchmarks tumbled, with the Sensex dropping 1,484 points and the Nifty falling below 25,350.

The sell-off was led by banking and metal stocks, signalling pressure on those sectors and raising caution for investors.
